arguments.value: Antonio Miguel Pozos is a Judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Born in Berkeley, California, in 1982, he earned an A.B. from Harvard University in 2004 and a J.D. from the University of Michigan Law School in 2007. He was in private practice in Washington, D.C., from 2007 to 2010 and from 2011 to 2014, clerked for Judge Anthony J. Trenga of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia from 2010 to 2011, served as a trial attorney in the Fraud Section of the Criminal Division at the U.S. Department of Justice from 2014 to 2017, practiced in Philadelphia from 2018 to 2026, and was a lecturer in law at the University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School from 2020 to 2021 and from 2023 to 2025.
